question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Deleate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this question relates to the misspelling of one of the options provided.
 
• The correct spelling for the intended word is **"delete," **which means to remove or erase something.
 
• **"Deleate" **is not a recognized spelling in English.
 
• **"Delegate," "Devote," **and **"Design" **are all correctly spelled and are common English words.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delegate:** To designate or entrust (an authority, task, etc.) to another person.
 
• **Devote: **To dedicate or allot time, resources, or oneself to a particular activity or cause.
 
• **Design: **To plan and make decisions about (something that is being built or created); to create the plans, drawings, etc., that show how (something) will be made.
